title: Northstar Supply Competitive Intelligence Brief (offline, rule-based)
notice: All companies, products, prices, and reviews in this report are FICTIONAL sample data from the Northstar Supply teaching project (10 Weeks to AI Agents). This is not real market research.

run.producer: Deterministic offline briefing (no LLM). Rule-based templates over the same tools; priorities are the rubric baseline without analyst judgment; review aspects use hand-labeled reference annotations.

executive_summary: Top signal (high): PeakTrail Ridge Insulated Bottle (32 oz): price decrease — Listed price decrease of 17.9% ($39.00 USD → $32.00 USD). Signals by rubric baseline: 2 high, 1 medium, 1 low. Customer sentiment: 8 of the 20 reviews in our sample mention problems with lid leakage. 2 changes did not warrant an alert, and 3 items need verification. This is a rule-based offline briefing; run the LLM agent for interpretation of messaging and context.
